name: Helene Hart
source: Helene Hart is the president of Industricorp, and a former client of Bedside Logistics. She calls upon The Man and his team in order to bring her company's employees the same joys that she felt not so long ago. She is a free spirit, preferring to avoid doing anything at all where possible, but still respected and admired for being a gentle and kind superior.
